title: Count Uppercase and Lowercase Letters
statement: Given a string text, return how many uppercase letters and how many lowercase letters it contains.
think: What is the task asking? Count letters in two categories: uppercase and lowercase.
What is the key operation? Inspect each character once and classify it.
What wording signals stand out? Count, uppercase, lowercase.
What is the brute force idea? Multiple passes for uppercase and lowercase separately.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass with two counters.
What are the edge cases? Digits, spaces, punctuation, empty string.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I scan the string once and increment one of two counters based on char.IsUpper/IsLower.
algorithm: Iterate through each character in text
interview: I would use a simple linear scan. I inspect each character once and increment either the uppercase or lowercase counter.
ru: Это простая задача на один проход по строке. Каждый символ проверяем и относим в одну из двух категорий.
visualExplanation:
text = "AnNa123!"
A -> upper
n -> lower
N -> upper
a -> lower
1,2,3,! -> ignore

critical: Treat digits or symbols as letters
important: Forget to use both IsUpper and IsLower

gaps: Important: be comfortable with basic char classification
Nice to have: explain why one pass is enough
constraints: Assume text can contain letters, digits, spaces, and punctuation.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan problem because we only need one pass and simple per-character classification.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because we do not need counts per unique character.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no left/right movement.
